info.title: YOB Storefront & Auth API
info.description:
Frappe RPC-style API. Every response is wrapped by Frappe in an outer `message` object; the inner body is the YOB envelope (`data`/`notice`/`meta` on success, `errors[]` on failure). There is no `success` boolean: branch on HTTP status, then `errors[0].code`.

CSRF is Frappe's own. Non-GET requests need `X-Frappe-CSRF-Token`, obtained from login or `get_session_context`. Authenticated calls must traverse the edge proxy that sets `X-YOB-Original-Host`.
